title: 1D Batch Processing and SAND Using NMRPipe
author: Christopher Esselman
materials: Sign in to your NMRbox account.

steps.title: Start C-shell Terminal
steps.instruction: Open a terminal window, type `csh` and press Enter to start the C-shell.

steps.title: Download sand_demo1 Archive
steps.instruction: Run the command `wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edisonomics/FLAnalyzer/main/sand/sand_demo1.tar` in the terminal to retrieve the sand_demo1 files.

steps.title: Extract sand_demo1 Archive
steps.instruction: Extract `sand_demo1.tar` to your home directory.

substeps.instruction: Option 1 (GUI): Open the File Manager, right‑click `sand_demo1.tar` and choose “Extract Here”.
Option 2 (CLI): Run `tar -xvf sand_demo1.tar` in the terminal.

steps.title: Copy .com Files to Data Directory
steps.instruction: Navigate into the extracted `sand_demo1` folder and copy each “.com” file into the directory that holds your unprocessed NMR data.

substeps.instruction: GUI method: drag the files.
CLI method: `cp ./sand_demo1/*.com /path/to/unprocessed_data/`.

steps.title: Place and Edit meta.tab
steps.instruction: Create a copy of `meta.tab` in the same directory as the unprocessed data, then edit it:

substeps.instruction: Change the second column (DIR_NAME) to match the spectrum directories you will process.
Change the third column (TITLE) to a descriptive name without spaces.
Delete any rows that correspond to folders you do not want to process.

steps.title: Run Batch Processing with all.com
steps.instruction: Open a new terminal, `cd` to the directory containing the unprocessed data, the “.com” files, and `meta.tab`, then execute `./all.com`.

substeps.instruction: Processing finishes when a graphical image of the spectra appears.
The processed files are placed in a newly created folder named `interp`.

steps.title: View Processed Spectra
steps.instruction: To view the spectra at any time, run `specView.tcl -in interp/*.ft1` from the directory that contains both the unprocessed and processed data.

steps.title: Automate meta.tab Creation (optional)
steps.instruction: Use the provided `metaTabCreate.sh` script to generate `meta.tab` automatically.

substeps.instruction: Place `metaTabCreate.sh` in the same folder as `meta.tab`.
Make it executable (right‑click → Properties → Permissions → “Allow this file to run as a program”).
Run `./metaTabCreate.sh` and supply a title for the dataset (no spaces).
After creation, verify that `meta.tab` contains rows only for the spectra you intend to process.

steps.title: Correct Phasing Errors (if needed)
steps.instruction: If automatic zero‑order phasing is imperfect, re‑phase the affected spectra:

substeps.instruction: Visualize the spectra and identify those with bad phase.
In `meta.tab`, change the “P0” (and “P1” if needed) values for those spectra from `Auto` to `0.0`.
Re‑run the batch processing with `./all.com`.

steps.title: Open Spectra in nmrDraw
steps.instruction: After processing, open a new terminal, `cd` to the `interp` folder, and run `nmrDraw` (best used with a three‑button mouse).

steps.title: Manually Adjust Phase and Update meta.tab
steps.instruction: Within nmrDraw, manually phase spectra and record the new phase values:

substeps.instruction: Select a spectrum: File → Select File.
Scroll through spectra with the top sliding bar; double‑click the desired spectrum.
Adjust zero‑order and first‑order phase using the sliders (drag left‑click).
When satisfied, note the values shown in the red box.
Replace the corresponding zero‑order and first‑order values in `meta.tab` for that spectrum.
Re‑execute `./all.com` to apply the corrected phase.

steps.title: Download run_sand and copy_csv_sand Scripts
steps.instruction: From the FLAnalyzer GitHub repository (https://github.com/edisonomics/FLAnalyzer/tree/main/sand) download `run_sand` and `copy_csv_sand.sh`.

steps.title: Prepare Scratch Directory on NMRbox
steps.instruction: Place `run_sand` in your NMRbox scratch directory (`/scratch/xxxx/username`). Determine `xxxx` by running `pwd` on NMRbox; the number appears before your username (e.g., `/home/nmrbox/0030/cesselman` → scratch path `/scratch/0030/cesselman`). If no number is present, the path is `/scratch/username`.

steps.title: Make run_sand Executable
steps.instruction: Make `run_sand` executable using the same method described for `metaTabCreate.sh` (right‑click → Properties → Permissions → allow execution).

steps.title: Copy interp Folder to Scratch
steps.instruction: Copy the `interp` folder created during batch processing into the scratch directory.

substeps.instruction: `cp -r /path/to/interp /scratch/xxxx/username/`

steps.title: Edit run_sand Script Parameters
steps.instruction: Open `run_sand` in an editor and modify the indicated lines:

substeps.instruction: Line 4: `scratch_directory="/scratch/xxxx/username"`
Line 5: `interp_directory="/scratch/xxxx/username/interp"`
Line 8: `local_directory="/home/nmrbox/xxxx/username/Documents/"` (ensure this local folder exists).
Line 20: Adjust the ppm range to cover your peaks (replace `10ppm` and `-0.5ppm` with appropriate values).
Save and close the file.

steps.title: Distribute Work Across Multiple VMs
steps.instruction: On NMRbox you can run up to three VMs simultaneously; repeat steps 14‑17 on each VM, assigning different subsets of spectra to each (e.g., 1‑48 on VM 1, 49‑96 on VM 2, 97‑140 on VM 3). Delete any spectra in each VM’s `interp` folder that should not be processed by that VM.

steps.title: Execute run_sand on Each VM
steps.instruction: On each VM, open a terminal, `cd` to the scratch directory, and run `./run_sand`.

steps.title: Assess Individual SAND Results
steps.instruction: In the local directory where SAND results are saved, navigate to a specific spectrum folder and run:

substeps.instruction: `specView.tcl -in ft/*.ft1 sim/0001.ft1 simAll/1/*.ft1`

steps.title: Gather All SAND CSV Tables
steps.instruction: Download `copy_csv_sand.sh` from the FLAnalyzer GitHub (Step 12) and make it executable.

substeps.instruction: Edit the script:
Line 4: add the absolute path to the directory where CSV files will be copied.
Line 7: add the absolute path to the destination directory for the SAND output folders (the same path used in line 8 of `run_sand`).
Run `./copy_csv_sand.sh` to collect all CSV tables into a single directory for use with FLAnalyzer.

steps.title: Alternative Extraction and Copy Commands
steps.instruction: If preferred, extract the demo archive and copy the `.com` files via the command line:

substeps.instruction: `tar -xvf sand_demo1.tar`
`cp ./*.com ~/destination_folder/`
